Class Statistics

java.lang.Object
moldsim.model.Statistics
public class Statistics extends Object
Computes and stores statistical indicators for a simulation step.

This class analyzes a wall grid and derives aggregated metrics such as cell states distribution, mold intensity, and trend evolution compared to the previous simulation step.
